audience: child care centers and preschools that run on CentreCareOS

useCases.title: See who is checked in today
useCases.text: List the check-in and check-out records of a day. Compare the result with the students of each room.

useCases.title: Find pending invoices by family
useCases.text: List the invoices with a pending status. Open one invoice to read its payment history and the parent it belongs to.

useCases.title: Compare room headcount with capacity
useCases.text: Read the capacity and the staff of each room. Then count the students assigned to it.

useCases.title: Read the daily report summary
useCases.text: Get the daily report summary of a date, for example yesterday. Ask the assistant for a short overview.

useCases.title: Review the admissions waitlist
useCases.text: List the waitlist entries and read the billing plans. Use them to plan the next enrollments.

useCases.title: Check incident reports and the calendar
useCases.text: List the incident reports and the school calendar events. Prepare for a staff meeting.
